reason: A planning and execution assistant for turning rough 3D briefs into software-aware scene direction packs and staged build guidance, with an optional DeepSeek API adapter.

summaries.zh: 将粗略的三维创意简报转化为适用于 Blender、Three.js、Houdini 或 C4D 的场景方向方案与分步构建指导。
summaries.en: Turns rough 3D briefs into software-aware scene direction packs and staged build guidance for Blender, Three.js, Houdini, or C4D.

capabilities: Generates structured creative direction packs for 3D scenes
Provides camera, composition, lighting, material, geometry, motion, and render-setting guidance
Produces staged build steps, negative prompts, showcase copy, hashtags, and risk flags
Optionally uses a DeepSeek server adapter requiring a DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable
Registers a runtime skill for Blender, Three.js, Houdini, and C4D briefs
